noncomputable def VTask.prevFixed {α : Type u} [CompleteLattice α] (f : α →o α) (x : α) (hx : f x ≤ x) : Function.fixedPoints f :=
begin
  let g := λ y, f y ≤ x,
  have hg : ∀ y, g y ↔ y ∈ Function.fixedPoints f, from 
    λ y, ⟨λ hy, by rw hy, λ hy, by rw hy,⟩,
  let h := λ y, (f y, g y),
  have hh : ∀ y, h y = f y ∧ g y, from
    λ y, by simp only [h],
  let s := { y | g y },
  have hs : s.nonempty, from
    let y := x,
    let hy := hx,
    have gy : g y, from hy,
    ⟨y, gy⟩,
  have heq : s = Function.fixedPoints f, from
    eq_of_subset_and_subset
      (subset_trans (image_subset_range _ _)
        (by simp only [Function.range_comp]))
      (by simp only [Function.image_range]),
  exact ⟨s.choose, heq⟩,
end
